facts.fact: Birr Metrics reports a draft access to information proclamation to replace Proclamation 590/2008, first drafted in 2018, has been forwarded to the Ministry of Justice and has not been presented to the Council of Ministers.
Birr Metrics reports Ethiopia's access to information framework dates from Proclamation No. 590/2008, which the draft is meant to replace.
